title: AuditEntry
description: A single append-only audit record in the hash-chained JSONL WAL. The chain algorithm is the single source of truth shared by Rust (src/audit/store.rs) and TS (src/alp-nlp/chain.ts): entry_hash = SHA-256(prev_hash || canonical_json(payload)), where payload is the record with prev_hash and entry_hash removed and canonical_json serializes keys in sorted order. The first entry links from the genesis hash (64 zero bytes).

id.description: Durable, monotonically increasing record id (persisted, never reset on restart).

sequence.description: Monotonic chain sequence, continues across restart and WAL rotation.

prev_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the previous record's entry_hash, or the genesis hash for the first record.

entry_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest over prev_hash || canonical_json(record without prev_hash and entry_hash).
